tools.name: search_plans
tools.description: Search current Australian mobile, prepaid, mobile broadband and nbn home internet plans from providers listed on Wireless Choices. Filter by price, included data, network, speed tier, contract and features. Results are ordered by lowest ongoing price among matching plans and each one carries the dat

tools.name: get_plan
tools.description: Return the details of one plan from Wireless Choices by plan type, provider slug and plan slug, including inclusions, current promotion terms and the link to its detail page. A plan is identified by its plan type, provider slug and plan slug.

tools.name: compare_plans
tools.description: Compare two to four plans from Wireless Choices side by side on price, data, network or technology, speed, contract and inclusions. Each plan is identified by its plan type, provider slug and plan slug.

tools.name: list_providers
tools.description: List the telco providers currently listed on Wireless Choices, with the network each one sells access to and how many plans of each type are listed. Each provider is returned with its name and slug.

tools.name: get_outage_status
tools.description: Return community outage reports made on Wireless Choices for one provider (provider_slug), one Australian postcode, or a provider in a postcode: the number of reports in the last 24 hours and the last 7 days by issue type and how many reports the counts are based on, plus up to 3 of the most recent

tools.name: get_outage_history
tools.description: Return resolved outages published on the carrier outage registers required by the ACMA (Telstra, Optus, TPG Telecom for Vodafone, and nbn) by provider (provider_slug), postcode or state, newest first.
